developer_profile.name: Lincoln Moki
developer_profile.core_claim: I build backend systems that stay correct when everything else goes wrong.

certifications.name: Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA)
certifications.focus: Cloud-native architecture, declarative configuration, container orchestration, and runtime workload management.

details.context: Retail point-of-sale system serving 10 active businesses where transaction latency and operational stability impacted checkout workflows.
details.engineering_challenge: Accelerate transaction processing speed without compromising financial or inventory data consistency.
details.what_i_built: Backend enhancements for core transaction execution and business logic routines utilized by retail merchants.
details.technical_decisions: Maintained linear, explicit execution paths and treated input validation as an architectural contract at service boundaries.
details.reliability_considerations: Handled malformed payloads, incomplete inputs, and race conditions to prevent ambiguous financial states.
details.outcome: Supported 10 retail businesses with 25% faster confirmed transaction processing speed.
details.lessons_learned: Performance optimizations are only viable if the underlying execution path remains deterministic and testable.

details.context: E-commerce client issuing rapid concurrent HTTP requests during active user UI interaction.
details.engineering_challenge: Out-of-order network responses arriving late caused older data to overwrite newer client state.
details.what_i_built: A request-ordering guard evaluating response freshness against sequential request counters before state mutations commit.
details.technical_decisions: Decoupled network arrival timing from state mutation authority. Requests out of order are rejected as stale.
details.reliability_considerations: Network delays are treated as expected runtime events rather than unexpected system errors.
details.outcome: Eliminated state corruption caused by race conditions. Quantitative metrics pending production log evaluation.
details.lessons_learned: Asynchronous state correctness requires an explicit sequence authority rather than assuming response order mirrors user intent.

details.context: Independent technical delivery of multiple client services across APIs, relational storage, and containerized deployments.
details.engineering_challenge: Translate varied business requirements into maintainable backend service boundaries with predictable data contracts.
details.what_i_built: Backend microservices, relational database schemas, and REST endpoints using Django, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL.
details.technical_decisions: Applied strict schema boundary checks, separated environment configs, and containerized runtime environments with Docker.
details.reliability_considerations: Enforced error validation at API entry points and managed relational database migrations as critical deployment operations.
details.outcome: Successfully delivered 6+ production apps and microservices to client specifications.
details.lessons_learned: Even small services require strict API contracts to prevent operational failures when dependencies evolve.

case_studies.title: Resilient Data Ingestion Pipeline (The Polite Scraper)

details.context: Fault-tolerant web crawler built to extract, clean, and structure catalog data from HTML sources without overloading remote hosts.
details.engineering_challenge: Prevent duplicate network requests on pipeline re-runs while enforcing strict rate limits and output schema validity.
details.what_i_built: An ETL pipeline featuring local SHA-256 caching, automated request delays, network timeout bounds, and Pydantic validation.
details.technical_decisions: Used lightweight HTML parsing over resource-heavy browser automation; standardized prices to float and timestamps to ISO-8601 UTC.
details.reliability_considerations: Cache hits bypass remote network calls completely (63/63 cache hits verified on re-execution runs).
details.outcome: Processed 60 records across 3 pages in 2.82s with 100% cache efficiency on re-runs.
details.lessons_learned: External HTTP sources must be treated as untrusted; data cleaning and typing must occur immediately at the boundary.

details.context: Multi-tier REST API evolution migrating from in-memory/SQLite prototypes to production PostgreSQL with JWT security.
details.engineering_challenge: Enforce strict session isolation and reproducible local-to-production deployment runtimes.
details.what_i_built: FastAPI service with Supabase JWT validation, Bearer token session guards, explicit logout routes, and multi-container Docker environments.
details.technical_decisions: Decoupled configuration into environment variables and orchestrated API and database tiers via Docker Compose.
details.reliability_considerations: Pre-logic Pydantic validation blocks malformed inputs; edge errors explicitly return 401 Unauthorized or 404 Not Found.
details.outcome: Built a production-ready containerized service stack with zero-friction onboarding and verified auth flows.
details.lessons_learned: Session revocation and error domains require the same engineering rigor as successful execution routes.

details.context: Production web platform built for a medical facility to present dental services and capture patient inquiries.
details.engineering_challenge: Maintain high site uptime and validate appointment form payloads to prevent lost or malformed customer submissions.
details.what_i_built: Responsive commercial web interface integrated with client-side form payload validation and booking endpoints.
details.technical_decisions: Sanitized form payloads before submission dispatch, maintaining a lightweight dependency footprint.
details.reliability_considerations: Form boundaries enforce complete data inputs to guarantee booking notifications arrive correctly formatted.
details.outcome: Deployed live site actively supporting client acquisition and commercial healthcare operations.
details.lessons_learned: Client-facing software reliability depends directly on predictable form submission logic.

specifications.experiment_type: LLM Vibe Coding & Code Generation Benchmarking
specifications.evaluation_subject: State Machine & Frame Render Loop Reliability

details.context: Experimental side project generated entirely via targeted LLM prompts to test state management capabilities of modern AI models.
details.engineering_challenge: Identify exact boundary conditions where LLM-generated code breaks in state-machine render loops.
details.what_i_built: Browser Canvas game with collision detection, score state evaluation, and asynchronous game ticks generated via structured prompts.
details.technical_decisions: Constrained generated outputs to vanilla JavaScript and HTML5 Canvas with zero external frameworks.
details.reliability_considerations: State bounds required manual review to prevent frame collision race conditions and tick timing drift.
details.outcome: Deployed operational game prototype while establishing clear failure-mode profiles for LLM code synthesis.
details.lessons_learned: AI tools generate rapid structural boilerplate, but human engineers remain necessary to enforce strict state invariants.
